metadata.title: Most Stocks Gained, but Chip Selloff Drags Market

content.text:
CONCLUDED
49 min ago
Most Stocks Gained, but Chip Selloff Drags Market
The Nasdaq, the S&P 500, and the Dow ended Thursday's session lower, but if you take a closer look, most of the market is actually holding up all right.
The tech-heavy Nasdaq saw the most dramatic declines since tech stocks led the selloff, down 1.5%. The S&P 500 fell 0.5% and the Dow dropped 0.2% or 105 points.
Chip stocks were the biggest drag on the indexes with heavy weights such as Nvidia and Broadcom dropping. But unlike Wednesday where the rest of the market worked to offset the losses and then some, the S&P 500 and the Dow's laggards were the dominant market forces.
